# `PageSize`

**Kind:** class  
**Module/package:** `com.pdfdancer.common.model`  
**SDK:** `com.pdfdancer.client:pdfdancer-client-java 2.0.0`

Represents PDF page dimensions, supporting both standard sizes and custom dimensions.
Dimensions are specified in points (1/72 inch).

## Declaration

```java
public class com.pdfdancer.common.model.PageSize
```
